test_case_name: Accept All Cookies and Access 'Servizi di Pagamento per gli Enti Pubblici' Details

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the cookie banner in the parent page
Click 'Business' in the main menu of the parent page
Click 'SCOPRI DI PIÙ' for 'Servizi di Pagamento per gli Enti Pubblici' in the child page
And then check that the details page for 'Servizi di Pagamento per gli Enti Pubblici' is displayed

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Enti Pubblici' and Search for a Service (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the main menu of the parent page
Type $name in the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search field in the child page (desktop)
Click the 'btn-search' button to submit the search in the child page (desktop)
And then check that the search results are displayed according to the entered query

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Enti Pubblici' and Search for a Service (Mobile)

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the main menu of the parent page
Type $name in the 'Cerca' search field in the child page (mobile)
Click the 'btn-search' button to submit the search in the child page (mobile)
And then check that the search results are displayed according to the entered query

test_case_name: Access Guest Login on 'Enti Pubblici' Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click 'Business' in the main menu of the parent page
Type $email in the 'E-mail' input field in the child page (desktop)
Type $name in the 'Password' input field in the child page (desktop)
Click 'ENTRA' button for guest login in the child page (desktop)
And then check that the guest user is logged in or receives an appropriate error message
